newsitem.title: JAPAN: Suzutan shares continue to slide.
newsitem.headline: Suzutan shares continue to slide.

text.p: Shares in Japanese retailer Suzutan Co Ltd continued to lose ground in Tuesday morning trade after the the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission launched a probe on Monday into alleged improper insider trading by the company's president.
The shares were down 13 yen to 434 yen at 0112 GMT.
A source close to the securities watchdog said on Monday that the commission had begun a probe into alleged improper insider trading by Suzutan president Katsurao Suzui.
Suzui admitted that he had sold shares in Suzutan prior to its announcement of a loss for the 1994/95 business year, but added he did not regard this as improper insider trading.
